name: instance-model-row-layout-phone
description: InstanceSheet .modelRow 360px phone geometry: .modelNameSlot shrinks and wraps a long unbroken model ID beside .modelMeta without pushing .modelMeta past the 360px sheet row.

mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-12: removing min-width: 0 and overflow-wrap: anywhere from .modelNameSlot causes the unbroken model label to spill 366.6px into .modelMeta on the 360px phone sheet.
